steps.content: In the ascending elevator, you get a secret call from K.K.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: I found a reliable outgoing communication channel and contacted Adjutant Nightingale. The guys from Rustfire won't notice it.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Indeed, something strange happened in <color=#fb9259>DisSea</color>. The FAC's troops have set out on their operation, but that area seems very messy now. They said they couldn't guarantee anything.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Besides, Adjutant has done some research on the Executive Committee. Julien didn't lie to you. Rustfire's executives and elite squad are all... dead now.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: She said someone else was behind this, but she worries more about your situation now. She doesn't believe Rustfire is still willing to cooperate with you. She hopes you can leave Drifter Camp as soon as you can and return to MBCC to regroup.
Her concerns make a lot of sense, but...

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: No matter what, please put an end to this.
Your last call ended with an ominous feeling. The thought of it makes your stomach lurch.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Leave with your friends, take as many people as you can. Tell Nightingale to focus on her tasks. We can't be too optimistic about the FAC's operation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll evaluate the situation and decide.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Okay.
There's a brief silence on the other end of the call.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Did Oak Casket say anything? Can you still stop that Black Ring thing in time?

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: The people here are genuinely nice. And you too. You always come up with something in the end. If you need anything from me, you must tell me.

steps.speaker: Options
options: ...Do your best to evacuate the camp now.

steps.content: How did it escalate to this? From BR-004's accident to Parma, then to that half-dead demi-Corpus, those tens of thousands of people, and the suddenly unearthed Black Ring crisis from eight years ago.

Why did you step into this unfamiliar place? What does this have to do with that unknown Black Ring from eight years ago? Isn't that history all made up? Who are you going to save this time? Do they really exist?
You begin to suspect all of this is a carefully designed trap, but you don't have time to investigate and verify this... because this Black Ring may erupt any second now.
What else can you do to stop the Black Ring from erupting?
(Scene change)
The elevator's gate opens. You see several familiar figures across the corridor. They're hiding behind the anti-Mania shield, shaking constantly.
This is an instinctive response. But for the first time, you feel that even if you win this time, you can't bring any real change.
